item.text:
The audit now has 24 confirmed findings. This pass added a concrete workspace build-matrix failure:

- **`cargo check --workspace --all-targets --all-features` fails in `kv_store_async`.** Feature unification enables `omnipaxos/unicache`, adding associated types to `Entry`, while [kv.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/examples/kv_store_async/src/kv.rs:5) still derives the ordinary `Entry` macro. Compilation stops with `E0046`.

The package-level exhaustive feature matrix passes, so the failure is specific to cross-package workspace unification.

Other latest verification:

- LFU cache serialization works through both JSON and bincode for the tested decoder snapshot.
- The LRU bincode failure is isolated: JSON and direct cloning pass.
- The captured implementation remains unchanged.

Full findings, code references, reproduction commands, and retained logs are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
